title: Published shoutbox snapshot
description: Approved messages and owner replies, written by `ragctl approve` / `ragctl publish` and committed. The site fetches this from the CDN at runtime; it never reads the backend. Contains only what is published: no author, no IP, no session id, no moderation state. NOTE: `id`, `count` and `version` are whole numbers but are typed `number`, not `integer` — scripts/lib/validate-json-schema.mjs is dependency-free and knows only JS typeof results, so `integer` fails every valid file. Same convention as skills-registry.schema.json.

version.description: Shape version. The reader refuses anything it does not recognise and falls back to the empty state, rather than half-rendering a structure whose meaning changed.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601, stamped when the snapshot was written.

count.description: Must equal threads.length. A mismatch means a truncated or hand-edited file, which the runtime guard also rejects.

id.description: The queue row id, as typed into `ragctl approve`.

body.description: The visitor's message, normalised by the gate. Rendered with textContent, never as markup.

at.description: ISO 8601 approval time. Rendered as a date only.

reply.description: The owner's reply, or null. Null far more often than not.
